svg.aria-label: Detailed Elephant-Goldfish development protocol sequence with five participants: you the engineer, the Elephant (deep context), the design document (source of truth), fresh-context Goldfish reviewers, and the repository of code and tests. An optional bootstrap maps the codebase. Phase 1 explores the idea and spawns six independent reviewers across six lenses. Phase 2 writes the specification with an iterate loop over design sections. Phase 3 challenges the design through five review stages: Initial Zoom Out, Comprehension, Design Critique, Intermediate Zoom Out and Implementation Readiness. Phase 4 resolves findings and approves the final specification, with an optional independent re-review. Phase 5 builds and verifies against the approved specification.
svg.title: Elephant-Goldfish — Detailed Development Protocol
